mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit renal prostaglandin synthesis, reducing renal blood flow and increasing fluphenazine levels through reduced renal clearance; concurrent use also increases anticholinergic and extrapyramidal side effects.
action: Monitor for increased fluphenazine adverse effects including extrapyramidal symptoms, anticholinergic effects, and orthostasis; consider alternative analgesia or use lowest effective NSAID dose with gastric protection.
